baseline.method: Reproduced unchanged original ZDIpy magnetic maximum-entropy reconstruction

nrmse_definition: RMS spatial error divided by reference dynamic range, independently per required component.
reference_kind: No actual surface truth. Only target-independent local line profiles/geometry calibration loaded; no reconstructed map comparison.
observation_metric: mean squared standardized residual over all 16 by 89 measured samples; diagonal variance assumption
entropy_definition: Negative signed entropy sum l[a asinh(a/(2m))-sqrt(a?+4m?)+2m] over real and imaginary alpha/beta/gamma, m=100G, l1..15. Coefficients inferred independently from submitted physical field; invisible imaginary m0 is fixed zero.
